title: C/Zephyr: multi-root conflict resolution (spec 02a 2a.5) absent; RPL version change does not reset SFN
description: Requirements (all MUST): R-02a-029 apply ordered deterministic selection criteria; R-02a-031 verify candidate beacon sig before criteria; R-02a-032..034 failed-sig discard/no state transition; R-02a-036 highest DODAG Preference; R-02a-037 lowest stratum; R-02a-039 smaller link-local IID tiebreak; R-02a-045/R-02a-022 RPL version change MUST reset SFN relative to new root. Classification: not-implemented in C — no root-selection module anywhere in lichen/subsys/lichen/ (rpl/dodag.c and rpl/messages.c parse preference/stratum for wire format only; tdma.c:79-136 lichen_ccp_fsm_event is the spec-09 14.8 five-state machine, not 2a.5); tdma.c:111-114 reaches DRIFTING on LICHEN_CCP_EVENT_RPL_VERSION but never resets SFN. Python and Rust are implemented+tested: python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:124-256 (select_root, compare_iid), rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:964-1003. Suggested placement: port MultiRootState semantics to lichen/subsys/lichen (new file alongside tdma.c), wire SFN reset on version change; vectors ccp16-desync.json multi_root_version_conflict_desync + new C harness. Related: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.12 (C desync FSM absent). From spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (docs/spec-coverage.md R-02a-022/029-047).
